cell: logical 1x1x1 on 0.55 m grid; mount = Socket_Mount_Bottom

R4M_Blink_ROOT.style: R41_Turret_v6.1 standard (heavy industrial armour + team colour)

R4M_Blink_Housing.role: static hex reactor drum; mounts from BELOW (Socket_Mount on the -Y face)

R4M_Blink_Crystal.role: phase crystal: translates along local Y and spins about local Y

R4M_Blink_Petal_1.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

R4M_Blink_Petal_2.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

R4M_Blink_Petal_3.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

R4M_Blink_Petal_4.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

R4M_Blink_Petal_5.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

R4M_Blink_Petal_6.role: emitter petal: rotates about local X (PetalHinge_k): -16 deg closed bud, 22 deg open

Socket_Mount.role: mount face centre on the cell BOTTOM, normal -Y

notes: Petal knuckles sit 3 mm above the hinge blocks (pin clearance so the petal root clears the drum when opening).
Mounted from below (cell -Y face) so the petals have the free upper half of the cell; all moving parts stay inside the cell.
